title: Abyssal Worms
tagline: Glowing worms crawling the floor of a deep, dark sea.
teaser: The worms of a 1980 terminal reborn as bioluminescent creatures of the deep, eight species of them, crawling exactly where the original program sent them. Change how many and how fast, let them leave glowing trails, or split the screen to watch the old terminal beside them.

manPage.synopsis: worms — watch worms wander; change how many and how fast.
manPage.description: Eric P. Scott’s worms animated little worms crawling around a display terminal. It returns as a smooth, colourful screensaver.

howToPlay: Let the worms crawl; S opens the settings.
Change how many there are, how long and how fast.
C shows the 1980 terminal; V splits the screen.

packages.title: Side by side
packages.description: Move the divider to compare the old screen with the new.

packages.title: Luminous trail

packages.title: Plankton feast

packages.description: Bring all eight species into the abyss at once.

packages.description: Start the worms with a command line of your own.
